connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the getqlows account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: QLOWS_TOKEN
env.description: qlows API token. Mint one at https://app.qlows.com/mcp or run `qlows-mcp login`.

env.name: QLOWS_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the qlows API host. Defaults to https://app.qlows.com.
